titleText: JTF News: Deutsche Welle, BBC News
mainText: Three women with links to ISIS were arrested in Australia upon return.
President Trump issued a deadline to the European Union regarding approval of a trade deal with the United States.
Approximately 40 passengers previously disembarked from a ship at St. Helena where Hantavirus was detected.
China announced suspended death sentences for former defence ministers.
The U.S. military reported intercepting attacks on three Navy ships in the Strait of Hormuz.
